jsonSchema.description:
A workbook upload. JSON with base64 content: framework 0.2.5 rejects binary request
bodies that carry query or path fields, and agents can call this over MCP too.

contentBase64.description: Standard base64 of the .xlsx bytes (at most about 1.5 MB decoded).

jsonSchema.description: Worksheet name; the first sheet when omitted.
